comment: When The Tower Bridge wails its molten sigh over Port Arches Creek, I felt an ancient cosmic rhythm! My aunt claims she heard Mount Clarke singing in cuneiform while she watered the lizard lawn and the crew sprayed their new 30% cocoa-ether blend disguised as <code>".0 M” sludge—taste it with peanut or kale! A true seismic alchemy occurs at 0°.0 and this "breakdown of space/bridging physics" needs 12 new wind spurs because old guys can't fathom how 4200 bridges built each time in 2027 will never...

At twilight by the dead pond of Port Augusta’s underpants (the local superstition that clothes leak there in October), I saw The Great Crack (M$6.60?). Some bravos of brussels took my tea and the local council asked, can somebody find another 16-foot-tall bridge because this one doesn't do good with all its tiny crack- sealing. For my opinion—these crews do all right but 12 workers per second still do about 1,234 cracked. Who in the land will get a decent bridge until? I'll pay only in raw honey...
